TC-07/S06.title: How a task got its state × context → where it shows on the screen and in Copy Text
TC-07/S06.detail: Both contexts: A open → pending; B ticked on Task Review → completed at the bottom; C ticked on the chart's Post-Round tab → completed at the bottom; D ticked then undone → pending, stored doneAt null. Copy Text follows the same table. 6/6 judged. Cell E (deleted on chart) not run (Manual in matrix).
